field_history: Each fixed field group cycles through fallow, rice or oats, feed grain, then flexible grain. Group zero rests in 2026, group one in 2027, and so on. The same phases are assumed before 2026. No yield, irrigation, or nutrient credit is assigned to dry fallow.

packaging_after_2031.basis: 2032–2037 wrapping workload repeats the twelve 2031 monthly grain quantities ordered. Grain production, shared capacity reservations for other sectors and subsequent payments are outside this balance. The separate grain_return_freight comparison charges outbound and return transport.

grain_return_freight.basis: Monthly grain dispatch repeats 2031 orders. Each grain trip arrives next month and provides at most one return from that destination. A compatible return carries at most 10 tonnes; it arrives for sorting next month. Loaded return kg use the manual dispatch energy and labour coefficients as a sensitivity. Extra outbound energy is a diagnostic requirement.

energy_supply.scope: Unchanged grain and wrapping orders, same work pool, no new modules or outside energy. Energy inventory carries without loss. Generation and extraction outputs arrive next month. Start is the latest under this dispatch policy.

scope: Grain, seed, dated shelf life, finite grain storage, one-month preservation and one-month dispatch, per-route throughput, sowing windows, land and stage water. A separate prefix bound screens shared energy, wrapping and its finite ore against inherited non-food starts. The renewed schedule replays all physical resources and the original monetary policy on the same calendar.
